definition_en: A curved surface, such as an aircraft wing, shaped to produce lift as air flows over it.
example_en: Engineers test each aerofoil shape in a wind tunnel before it is built.
example_uz: Muhandislar har bir aerofoil shaklini qurishdan oldin shamol tunnelida sinab ko'rishadi.

definition_en: The movement of air through or around an object or space.
example_en: Smooth airflow over the wing reduces drag during flight.
example_uz: Qanot ustidagi silliq havo oqimi parvoz paytida qarshilikni kamaytiradi.

definition_en: A protective garment worn over the front of the body to keep clothes clean while working.
example_en: Participants in the art club should bring an old shirt or apron.
example_uz: San'at to'garagi ishtirokchilari eski ko'ylak yoki fartuk olib kelishlari kerak.

definition_en: A short written account of a person's life and background.
example_en: Add a short bio and a recent photo to your profile.
example_uz: Profilingizga qisqa tarjimai hol va so'nggi rasm qo'shing.

definition_en: Able to decay naturally and turn into compost rather than staying as waste.
example_en: The packaging is fully compostable and breaks down within weeks.
example_uz: Qadoqlash to'liq kompostga aylanadigan va bir necha hafta ichida parchalanadi.

definition_en: A situation in which two facts or statements cannot both be true.
example_en: Separate contradiction from information the passage never states.
example_uz: Ziddiyatni matnda umuman aytilmagan ma'lumotdan ajrating.

definition_en: Relating to informal talk or spoken conversation rather than formal writing.
example_en: The centre offers conversational English classes for beginners.
example_uz: Markaz boshlang'ich darajadagilar uchun suhbat uslubidagi ingliz tili darslarini taklif etadi.

definition_en: An open space enclosed by walls or buildings, often in the middle of a building.
example_en: Clay panels were fitted around the courtyard to keep it cooler in summer.
example_uz: Yozda hovlini salqin saqlash uchun uning atrofiga loy panellar o'rnatildi.

definition_en: Having great importance in determining the result of something.
example_en: For wider adoption, careful preparation appears to be decisive.
example_uz: Kengroq qo'llash uchun sinchkovlik bilan tayyorgarlik hal qiluvchi ahamiyatga ega.

definition_en: Having parts or units crowded closely together.
example_en: Planted roofs make dense cities more resilient to heat and storms.
example_uz: Ekilgan tomlar zich shaharlarni issiqlik va bo'ronlarga chidamliroq qiladi.

definition_en: Able to be trusted or relied on.
example_en: The system needs a dependable water supply to work well.
example_uz: Tizim yaxshi ishlashi uchun ishonchli suv ta'minoti kerak.

definition_en: A situation in which people have different opinions about something.
example_en: There was some disagreement among residents about the new plan.
example_uz: Yangi reja bo'yicha aholi orasida ba'zi kelishmovchiliklar bo'ldi.

definition_en: The quality of being able to last a long time without being damaged.
example_en: Modern materials have improved the durability of planted roofs.
example_uz: Zamonaviy materiallar ekilgan tomlarning chidamliligini oshirdi.

definition_en: Safe and suitable to be eaten.
example_en: Some rooftop gardens now grow edible plants for local kitchens.
example_uz: Ba'zi tom bog'lari endi mahalliy oshxonalar uchun yeyish mumkin bo'lgan o'simliklar yetishtiradi.

definition_en: Land that is used or suitable for farming.
example_en: The seed vault protects crop varieties from farmland around the world.
example_uz: Urug' ombori dunyoning turli dehqonchilik yerlaridagi ekin navlarini himoya qiladi.

definition_en: A living organism, such as a mould or mushroom, that feeds on organic matter.
example_en: Fungal packaging is grown from fungus and waste plant fibre.
example_uz: Zamburug'li qadoqlash zamburug' va o'simlik chiqindisi tolasidan o'stiriladi.

definition_en: Having or showing good physical or mental condition.
example_en: Healthier soil helps plants survive longer periods without rain.
example_uz: Sog'lomroq tuproq o'simliklarga yomg'irsiz uzoqroq davrga bardosh berishga yordam beradi.

definition_en: A small creature with six legs and usually wings, such as a bee or ant.
example_en: Wildflowers on the roof attract useful insects such as bees.
example_uz: Tomdagi yovvoyi gullar asalari kabi foydali hasharotlarni jalb qiladi.

definition_en: Complete knowledge or skill in a subject or activity.
example_en: Regular review builds real mastery of new vocabulary over time.
example_uz: Muntazam takrorlash vaqt o'tishi bilan yangi so'zlarni mukammal egallashga olib keladi.

definition_en: Regularly moving from one region or climate to another, especially with the seasons.
example_en: Restored urban streams give migratory birds a place to rest.
example_uz: Tiklangan shahar soylari ko'chib yuruvchi qushlarga dam olish joyini beradi.

definition_en: To make someone believe something that is not true.
example_en: A single successful test can mislead readers about long-term reliability.
example_uz: Bitta muvaffaqiyatli sinov o'quvchilarni uzoq muddatli ishonchlilik haqida chalg'itishi mumkin.

definition_en: Giving the wrong idea or impression about something.
example_en: A short trial can be misleading if conditions later change.
example_uz: Sharoitlar keyinchalik o'zgarsa, qisqa sinov chalg'ituvchi bo'lishi mumkin.

definition_en: Not very large in size or amount.
example_en: Insulation from the layers provides only a modest benefit in winter.
example_uz: Qatlamlardan olinadigan issiqlik izolyatsiyasi qishda faqat o'rtacha foyda beradi.

definition_en: Using or recording several different bands of light or radiation at once.
example_en: Multispectral cameras reveal plant stress invisible to the human eye.
example_uz: Ko'p spektrli kameralar inson ko'ziga ko'rinmaydigan o'simlik stressini aniqlaydi.

definition_en: A small shellfish with a dark shell that lives in rivers or the sea.
example_en: Freshwater mussels are early indicators of river water quality.
example_uz: Chuchuk suv midiyalari daryo suvi sifatining erta ko'rsatkichidir.

definition_en: A board fixed to a wall where public notices or messages are displayed.
example_en: Class times are posted on the noticeboard by the main entrance.
example_uz: Dars vaqtlari asosiy kirish qismidagi e'lonlar taxtasiga joylashtirilgan.

definition_en: A building with equipment for observing stars, weather, or other natural events.
example_en: The observatory shares its bird count data with citizen scientists.
example_uz: Observatoriya o'z qushlarni hisoblash ma'lumotlarini fuqarolik olimlari bilan baham ko'radi.

definition_en: To arrange or plan something in a systematic way.
example_en: Volunteers organise weekend surveys of local wildlife.
example_uz: Ko'ngillilar mahalliy yovvoyi tabiat bo'yicha dam olish kunlari so'rovlarini tashkil qilishadi.

definition_en: An insect or animal that carries pollen from one flower to another, helping plants reproduce.
example_en: Rooftop flowers give pollinators a place to feed in the city centre.
example_uz: Tomdagi gullar shahar markazida changlatuvchilarga oziqlanish joyini beradi.

definition_en: Happening or done before the usual or proper time.
example_en: It would be premature to call the pilot project a full success.
example_uz: Pilot loyihani to'liq muvaffaqiyat deb atash muddatidan oldin bo'lardi.

definition_en: The amount of rain that falls in a particular place over a period of time.
example_en: A planted roof absorbs a proportion of heavy rainfall.
example_uz: Ekilgan tom kuchli yog'ingarchilikning bir qismini shimib oladi.

definition_en: Water that has fallen as rain and been collected.
example_en: Rainwater collected from the roof is used to water the garden.
example_uz: Tomdan yig'ilgan yomg'ir suvi bog'ni sug'orish uchun ishlatiladi.

definition_en: To operate or continue over a period of time, or to move quickly on foot.
example_en: The best results have come from projects that ran long enough to observe a full seasonal cycle.
example_uz: Eng yaxshi natijalar to'liq mavsumiy davrni kuzatish uchun yetarlicha davom etgan loyihalardan kelib chiqdi.

definition_en: To design something again in a different way in order to improve it.
example_en: Civic learning spaces are being redesigned rather than replaced.
example_uz: Fuqarolik ta'lim maskanlari almashtirilmasdan qayta loyihalashtirilmoqda.

definition_en: If money is refundable, it can be given back if you are not satisfied or change your plans.
example_en: Booking fees for the class are not refundable after the session starts.
example_uz: Dars boshlangandan keyin bron qilish to'lovi qaytarilmaydi.

definition_en: Happening or done many times in a row.
example_en: The same materials were tested repeatedly under different weather conditions.
example_uz: Bir xil materiallar turli ob-havo sharoitlarida qayta-qayta sinovdan o'tkazildi.

definition_en: A small amount of something that remains after the main part has gone or been used.
example_en: Fungal packaging turns agricultural residue into a useful material.
example_uz: Zamburug'li qadoqlash qishloq xo'jaligi qoldiqlarini foydali materialga aylantiradi.

definition_en: The ability of something or someone to recover quickly after difficulty or damage.
example_en: Planted roofs can make dense cities more resilient to heat and storms.
example_uz: Ekilgan tomlar zich shaharlarni issiqlik va bo'ronlarga chidamliroq qilishi mumkin.

definition_en: The quality of having an uneven or rough surface.
example_en: Sensors record how lift changes as the roughness of the surface is altered.
example_uz: Sensorlar sirt g'adir-budurligi o'zgarganda ko'tarilish kuchi qanday o'zgarishini qayd etadi.

definition_en: The small part of a plant from which a new plant can grow.
example_en: The seed vault protects crop varieties in case of disaster.
example_uz: Urug' ombori falokat yuz berganda ekin navlarini himoya qiladi.

definition_en: A flat board fixed to a wall or in a cupboard, used for holding objects.
example_en: Rows of shelves once occupied most of the library's floor area.
example_uz: Bir vaqtlar kutubxonaning katta qismini tokcha qatorlari egallagan edi.

definition_en: A woody plant smaller than a tree, often with several stems growing from the base.
example_en: Low shrubs were planted along the restored stream bank.
example_uz: Tiklangan soy qirg'og'i bo'ylab past butalar ekildi.

definition_en: A place where something is located or where an activity happens.
example_en: The findings refer to conditions at one particular site.
example_uz: Topilmalar faqat bitta ma'lum joydagi sharoitlarga tegishli.

definition_en: A word that has the same or nearly the same meaning as another word.
example_en: Scan for synonyms rather than expecting the exact same words.
example_uz: Xuddi bir xil so'zlarni emas, balki sinonimlarni qidiring.

definition_en: Violent or unpredictable movement of air or water.
example_en: The wind tunnel test shows how turbulence forms behind the wing.
example_uz: Shamol tunneli sinovi qanot orqasida turbulentlik qanday hosil bo'lishini ko'rsatadi.

definition_en: Not known or definite; not sure.
example_en: The long-term effect of the new material is still uncertain.
example_uz: Yangi materialning uzoq muddatli ta'siri hali ham noaniq.

definition_en: To draw a line under a word or phrase, or to emphasise its importance.
example_en: Underline the paragraph's repeated idea before reading the headings.
example_uz: Sarlavhalarni o'qishdan oldin paragrafda takrorlangan g'oyani tagiga chizing.

definition_en: Continuing without any pause or interruption.
example_en: The recordings need several hours of uninterrupted quiet.
example_uz: Yozuvlar bir necha soat uzluksiz sokinlikni talab qiladi.

definition_en: Not able to be trusted or depended on.
example_en: A single short test can be an unreliable guide to long-term performance.
example_uz: Bitta qisqa sinov uzoq muddatli samaradorlik uchun ishonchsiz ko'rsatkich bo'lishi mumkin.

definition_en: Not right or appropriate for a particular purpose or situation.
example_en: Some plants are unsuitable for a shallow, windy rooftop.
example_uz: Ba'zi o'simliklar sayoz va shamolli tom uchun mos kelmaydi.

definition_en: The process of allowing fresh air to circulate in a space.
example_en: Good ventilation keeps the workspace comfortable in summer.
example_uz: Yaxshi shamollatish yozda ish maydonini qulay saqlaydi.

definition_en: Able to be seen or watched.
example_en: Restoration work made the early films viewable again.
example_uz: Tiklash ishlari eski filmlarni yana ko'rish mumkin qildi.

definition_en: A river, canal, or other route by which boats can travel, or through which water flows.
example_en: The project restores a hidden urban waterway.
example_uz: Loyiha yashirin shahar suv yo'lini tiklaydi.

definition_en: Suitable or comfortable to be worn, or (of technology) designed to be worn on the body.
example_en: A wearable sensor tracks the volunteer's route during the survey.
example_uz: Kiyib yuriladigan sensor so'rov davomida ko'ngillining marshrutini kuzatib boradi.

definition_en: Any day of the week except Saturday and Sunday.
example_en: Classes run on weekday evenings and one Saturday morning.
example_uz: Darslar ish kunlari kechqurun va bir shanba kuni ertalab o'tkaziladi.

definition_en: With a lot of wind blowing.
example_en: Rooftop gardens must be planned carefully because the site is windy.
example_uz: Tom bog'lari hudud shamolli bo'lgani uchun ehtiyotkorlik bilan rejalashtirilishi kerak.

definition_en: To remove something, or to leave a place or activity.
example_en: Funding was withdrawn before the second phase could begin.
example_uz: Ikkinchi bosqich boshlanishidan oldin moliyalashtirish olib qo'yildi.

definition_en: An area used for working, especially in an office.
example_en: The centre offers shared workspaces for local freelancers.
example_uz: Markaz mahalliy frilanserlar uchun umumiy ish joylarini taklif etadi.
